data.situation:
Lin's colleague Ibrahim brought a late draft to the team table. Another supervisor had chastised him in front of the group, and the sharp comment remained on the first page. Ibrahim said the repeated copying task had become monotonous; he also wanted more time for training in the pursuit of a different role. Jo asked him to separate the delayed work from the way the feedback had been given. On a nearby training notice, a different case described an employee who had been formally reprimanded for ignoring an inspection step. The two cases did not have the same procedure or consequence. Jo had discretion to change the feedback wording and rearrange an ordinary task within her team, but a formal disciplinary decision belonged to another process. Ibrahim agreed to finish the current correction and send a specific training request. Jo then replaced the public criticism with a message naming the unfinished sections and the time for their review. Revised feedback
Two sections of the draft need correction before the next handover. Please send them by three, and we will review the instructions together. I can use my discretion to change tomorrow’s copying task, provided that the required records are still completed. Your training request should explain which role you want to pursue and how the course would help with its tasks. Ibrahim: I want the training, but I do not want my request to sound like an excuse.
Jo: Explain what happened and what you will complete today. Then make the future request separately.
Lin: The task can be monotonous without making the deadline disappear.
Ibrahim: All right. I'll keep the correction and the training request in two clear messages.

readingBlocks.zh: 林的同事易卜拉欣把一份迟交的草稿带到团队桌旁。另一位主管曾当众斥责他，尖锐的批注仍留在首页。易卜拉欣说，反复抄录的任务变得单调，也希望为追求另一个岗位留出更多培训时间。乔请他把工作延期与反馈方式分别说明。旁边的培训告示讲了另一件事：一名员工因忽略检查步骤而受到正式训诫。两个案例的程序与后果并不相同。乔可以自行调整团队内的反馈措辞与日常任务，但正式纪律决定属于另一套程序。易卜拉欣同意完成当前修改，再提出具体培训请求。乔随后把当众批评改成了一条消息，列明未完成的部分及复核时间。

修改后的反馈
下次交接前，草稿的两个部分需要修正。请在三点前发来，我们一起复核说明。如果必需记录仍能完成，我可以自行调整明天的抄录任务。培训请求应该说明想争取哪个岗位，以及课程怎样帮助完成那个岗位的任务。

glossary.note: 及物动词 chastise somebody for + 行为；此处言语责备，不覆盖体罚的其他用义。
glossary.example: Another supervisor had chastised him in front of the group.
glossary.exampleZh: 另一位主管曾当众斥责他。

glossary.note: 本句被动动词 be reprimanded for + 行为；正式处分语境与一次当众斥责分开，原名词义未由本句覆盖。
glossary.example: An employee had been formally reprimanded for ignoring an inspection step.
glossary.exampleZh: 一名员工因忽略检查步骤而受到正式训诫。

glossary.example: The repeated copying task had become monotonous.
glossary.exampleZh: 反复抄录的任务变得单调乏味。

retrievalPrompts.function: The feedback left beside the draft
retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain the difference between the formal reprimand in the training notice and the public rebuke you witnessed.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 向同伴说明培训告示中的正式训诫与自己看到的一次当众责备分别是什么。
acceptableAnswers: Ibrahim was chastised in front of the group. The training notice describes a different employee who was formally reprimanded for missing an inspection step. The two cases have different procedures.

retrievalPrompts.function: The feedback left beside the draft
retrievalPrompts.cue: Request training while acknowledging your current tasks and explaining the future role you want.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 写一条培训请求，承认当前任务，同时解释想争取的未来岗位。
acceptableAnswers: I will complete the correction today. The repeated task has become monotonous, and I would like training in pursuit of a role with more responsibility for writing instructions.

retrievalPrompts.function: The feedback left beside the draft
retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain in your feedback reply what you may change at your discretion and the conditions on that permission.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 在反馈回复中说明可以自行调整什么，以及这一权限的条件。
acceptableAnswers: I have discretion to change tomorrow’s copying task, provided that the required records are completed. I will explain the change separately from any formal disciplinary process.

transferPrompt.function: The feedback left beside the draft
transferPrompt.cue: A student submits a club article late. Write a specific editorial reply addressing both the revision and the student's interest in learning the role.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 学校社团里有人迟交文章，编辑想给一条具体、自然的反馈。写一段既说明当前修改，也回应岗位学习目标的消息。
acceptableAnswers: Please correct the two unfinished sections by Friday. I have discretion to rearrange the next routine task once that work is complete. If you want training in pursuit of an editing role, explain which skills you need and how the course would help.
